entries.name: Iron Inquisition
entries.description: PLACEHOLDER motto. The church's hunters; the Castellan Watch is its city arm.

entries.name: Castellan Watch
entries.description: PLACEHOLDER motto. The city watch: Footmen and Watch Crossbowmen.

entries.name: Tallow Guild
entries.description: PLACEHOLDER motto. Renders the district's tallow; its mercenaries scour the cellars.

entries.name: Fourth Kiln Syndicate
entries.description: PLACEHOLDER motto. The Guild's foundry arm; runs the bone-mill.
